title: Audit: paired-plane binary factors do not establish the scalar endpoint
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Adds `research/paired-plane-scalar-mask-obstruction/`: an independent, source-bound missing-implication audit of PR #1825 at `d16fb8936795ff101e4d2f63cfdc6a25066ebabf`.

**The binary factorization and local plane-translation identities remain valid.** They do not establish the scalar data endpoint required by the proposed two-unpaid-coordinate contract.

For ports `(0,7)`, labels `(11,21)` have binary pairing one. The scalar decoder must have zero cross-coupling, but interpreting the certified columns as scalar factors gives

```
H[{0,7},{0,7}] = [[7,5],[5,7]].
```

With `x7=1` and dirty `y0=11`, the literal scalar layer returns `y0=16`, not `11`. Every parity-preserving integral lift keeps that forbidden coefficient odd. The same obstruction applies to 6,608 ordered pairs and cannot be removed by zero-copy endpoint corrections.

This is **not** a universal plane-port obstruction, a refutation of the binary identity or its intended optimistic screen, a new κ, or a selected-supplier change. Rational/complex refactorization, paid cancellation and operator-valued contracts remain open. The `C=126` planning profile does not by itself certify an implemented scalar decoder.

## Task and overlap

- Base: current main at session start, `0b1cccf86e2f5132ed286a26ef0a681a495740ea`.
- Task: `coverage-law-change`, refined to this candidate's scalar endpoint rather than repeating the unpaid-line argument or lever arithmetic; full TASK metadata included.
- Closest predecessors: #1825's matching/factorization; #1808 (`b3d9b9813e0f2e82d8379cd4dafa2a355a900a44`) budgets; [Discussion1587's plane endpoint](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1587#discussioncomment-18914510).
- Final overlap refresh: 543 open PRs and 529 discussion records, complete pagination at 2026-10-14 13:23–13:25 UTC. No corresponding scalar-mask audit found; diffs, nested files and all closed PRs were not exhaustively searched. PR1825's head was rechecked unchanged.
- [Coordination #1884](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1884). Ten isolated research instances were run; this is the one selected focused submission.

## Validation

Passed on CPython **3.12.12**, macOS arm64, including a fresh integrated-checkout replay:

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/paired-plane-scalar-mask-obstruction
# or:
uv run --python 3.12 --no-project python scripts/research_package.py \
  --package research/paired-plane-scalar-mask-obstruction
```

Evidence:
- All 12,544 binary factorization entries pass as a positive control.
- 11,560 forbidden plane-mask off-diagonal entries; 11,559 nonzero under the literal integer lift.
- 224 formal dirty scalar columns replayed.
- Valid fitting-matrix control accepted; six semantic negative controls rejected.
- Remote certificate retained byte-for-byte, authenticated by SHA256 and Git blob; selected inputs pinned.
- Separate direct calculation, without importing the verifier, reconstructed all 23 columns, checked the full binary identity and reproduced the coefficient 5 / dirty output 16 witness.

No predecessor executable is imported. Standard library only; optimized `-O` checks remain active. No hosted CI, native full supplier replay or all-size theorem verification claimed.

## Credit

Cinna Davis / `1337isnot1337` (#1825); ctoth and collaborators (Discussion1587); Josie Elliston (#1808); Rohan Arun, Jeremy Kothe, Hao Yan and the retained selected construction/decoder/geometry lineage. Apache-2.0. Prepared for Adam Gall with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in research, proof exposition, implementation and review. No independent human review or proof-assistant claim.

## Open next questions

Find an actual scalar fitting factorization for the paired-plane mask over Q or Q(i), then price its complete source/target-plane supports, restoration, routing and hosting. The README and TASK specify the exact first equations and missing implementation obligations.
